item.title: IAQ Sensor Networks & BMS Integration
item.description:
The gap between IAQ sensor specs and real BMS integration is where healthy-building projects fail. BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU on every breathing-zone sensor, sub-60s CO₂ polling for DCV, calibration logging.

item.title: Hydronic Balancing & Valve Authority
item.description:
Unbalanced chilled-water loops overfeed coils near the plant while the far end runs warm — and the pump burns extra kW. Valve authority ≥0.3, a balancing record, pump kW/L/s from BAS data.
https://help.xinca.com/a/water-side-control-valve-selection/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=woofaasocial
#HydronicBalancing #ThermalComfort #EnergyEfficiency

item.title: Air Handling Unit Coil Selection
item.description:
An undersized AHU heating coil leaves the plant doing the work at part load; an oversized cooling coil wrecks valve authority and humidity control. Face velocity, rows and fin spacing decide it.
https://help.xinca.com/a/air-handling-unit-coil-selection/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=woofaasocial
#HVAC #AirHandlingUnits #BuildingServices
